kimi-k2.7-code-run2.explanation: No long-lived async subscriptions or timers; operations are one-shot promise-based storage calls. n/a
No fetch calls in this module. n/a

All mutating ops run under withLock and create is deduped via dedupeOp. Residual: loadSeed does not dedupe concurrent reads with the same key, and in-flight load vs wipe can still serialize correctly via the lock.
No cached data reused across awaits except DB handle, which is opened once. n/a

Clean backend split; remaining coupling is the Platform.OS inline branch. Could be abstracted into a pluggable backend interface.
Still a single file with public API, two backends, mutex, crypto, validation; acceptable but could be split into smaller modules.
No empty catch blocks; all catch blocks log or throw. Appears eslint-clean.
Imports minimal and grouped. n/a

zeroize() is used on Uint8Arrays, but immutable JS strings (base64) and Array.from copies cannot be zeroized; residual exposure remains.
SecureStore is statically imported but every native call is gated by assertNativeAvailable(). The import still assumes the module exists in the bundle.
isAvailableAsync() checked before every native operation; import-time assumption remains.
All errors are wrapped as KeyStorageError with a code and re-thrown to callers.
No retry/backoff for storage failures; arguably correct because local keychain failures are generally not transient.

createAndStoreSeed throws on failure and wipes partial state; cleanup failure is logged but does not swallow the primary error.
createAndStoreSeed is deduped by key; loadSeed and wipe are serialized by lock but not deduped.
